name: CtrlS Bhopal Data Center at Badwai IT Park
notes: Greenfield AI-ready data center on a five-acre land parcel allotted by the Madhya Pradesh government at Badwai IT Park, Bhopal. Times of India reports Rs 500 crore investment, 12 MW capacity, approximately 200 jobs, and virtual launch/groundbreaking by the Chief Minister on 2025-04-27; DCD separately confirms groundbreaking and Badwai IT Park location.

name: Submer Madhya Pradesh AI-ready liquid-cooled data center program / Acharpura data centre allocation
developer: Submer Technologies / Government of Madhya Pradesh
notes: Submer's official 2025-07-28 release says it signed an MoU with the Government of Madhya Pradesh to jointly develop up to 1 GW of liquid-cooled, AI-ready datacenters in Madhya Pradesh. ETDatacenters reported on 2026-07-16 that the state allotted 15 acres in Acharpura industrial area for the data centre project; Acharpura is near/in the Bhopal industrial area. Capacity is program-scale planned capacity, not confirmed live IT load.

name: NIC National Data Centre Bhopal
developer: National Informatics Centre, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
notes: NIC Madhya Pradesh official page states establishment of an NIC National Data Centre at Bhopal, a MeitY initiative, is under process. Earlier PTI/Business Standard reporting from 2020 cited a Rajya Sabha reply that a 1,500-rack NDC would be established in phases on five acres allotted in Bhopal IT Park, with 250 racks in phase one and expansion capability to 500 racks. MW capacity not disclosed.
